question: Does the currently certified completed-U1 diagnostic stack contain a nonzero earlier-time low-k interval on which a backward-regularity/asymptotic primordial branch selector can be defined without extrapolating the production background or importing the historical CLASS metric as the completed-U1 solution?
certification_requirements: use the low-k modes that actually anchor the C10.65f O(k^2) seed, not higher-k histories that happen to start earlier
require a nonzero interval strictly earlier than a_on with simultaneously available production background/source support for those low-k anchors
do not extrapolate H, ordinary densities, thermodynamics, or production source histories below their persisted support
the analytic Khronon background may be noted as individually extendable for a>0, but this alone is insufficient to certify the coupled completed-U1 background/metric system
do not use historical CLASS phi/psi as the completed-U1 metric solution; the preferred A->Hamiltonian->momentum projector remains the only certified completed metric map
require TCA/hierarchy assumptions appropriate to the low-k gradient seed, but lack of a production support interval is already a decisive feasibility failure
preserve the independent same-full-action background/gravity-normalization caveat; a diagnostic historical production branch is not a derivation of the completed action's primordial background
distinguish a later-time boundedness condition from a primordial growing-mode selector: the former would be a new phenomenological boundary condition and is not silently substituted here

classification_rule.backward_interval_certified: a nonzero earlier-time common low-k support interval exists and all required completed-U1 diagnostic ingredients are certified on it
classification_rule.no_certified_pre_onset_interval: the common low-k production support begins at a_on, or another required ingredient lacks earlier support; backward/asymptotic selection cannot be claimed from the current evidence
classification_rule.technical_incomplete: the persisted support endpoints or parent provenance cannot be reconstructed unambiguously

next_if_no_interval: freeze C10.65l explicit pre-EFT/UV matching-interface contract for the eight fixed-C2 C10.65i amplitudes plus C2: define the minimal gauge-invariant boundary data and a phenomenological control prescription without claiming it is derived by the low-energy completed action; only then build conditional completed-U1 seeds and onset-shift tests
non_claims: not a proof that the UV theory cannot select a unique growing mode
not a proof that the analytic Khronon background fails before a_on
